papers.title: OS-ATLAS: A Foundation Action Model for Generalist GUI Agents

data_quality.detail: Same action labeled differently (tap vs click)

methodology.impact: High barrier to data collection and scaling

papers.relevance_to_sft: Shows that selective learning must handle platform-specific inconsistencies and demonstrates the critical importance of consistent data formatting for multi-domain fine-tuning

papers.title: Domain Shift Tuning over Knowledge Gap

optimization.detail: Size discrepancy between pre-training (16G-25TB) and target corpora

interpretability.detail: Latent knowledge representation difficult to interpret
interpretability.impact: Difficult to understand which parameters affect which capabilities

domain_similarity.detail: Benefits diminish when target domain similar to source
domain_similarity.impact: Method less effective for fine-grained task specialization

computation.detail: Optimal K determination requires intensive computation
computation.impact: Deferred to future work, limits practical applicability

papers.relevance_to_sft: Demonstrates catastrophic forgetting as key weakness of selective fine-tuning, emphasizes need for knowledge-aware parameter selection, and shows low-resource challenges are critical

papers.title: UniCon: Unidirectional Information Flow for Diffusion Models

computational.detail: Existing adapters double overhead; large adapters require 18GB+16GB gradients
computational.impact: Severely limits scalability of selective fine-tuning

computational.detail: Only reduces training overhead, not inference time

architecture.detail: Existing adapter designs assume U-Net structure
architecture.impact: Cannot be applied to transformer-based models

capability.detail: Modifying only intermediate features restricts generative abilities

papers.relevance_to_sft: Shows gradient computation as critical bottleneck, demonstrates importance of unidirectional information flow for efficiency, illustrates capability-efficiency trade-offs in selective methods

papers.title: MetaUrban: An Embodied AI Simulation Platform for Urban Micromobility

real_world_gap.detail: Only 90 object categories, missing location/layout distribution

generalization.detail: Simple scenarios work well (70% success) but complex social dynamics fail (50% success)
generalization.impact: Selective learning alone insufficient without proper data diversity

generalization.detail: Dramatic performance variations with terrain, pedestrians, obstacles

evaluation.detail: Limited to navigation tasks in specific environment
RGB sensors perform worst; LiDAR >> Depth >> RGB
evaluation.impact: Method highly dependent on input modality

papers.relevance_to_sft: Demonstrates that selective capabilities (e.g., social navigation) harder to learn than basic skills, shows selective training insufficient without data diversity, emphasizes importance of compositional approaches

papers.title: On the Generalization of Preference Learning with DPO

theory.detail: Generalization guarantees for preference learning lacking
theory.impact: Limited understanding of what generalizes in fine-tuning

theory.detail: Output space of sentences more complex than standard learning theory handles

scope.detail: May not apply to other preference learning methods
scope.impact: Unclear generalization to other selective fine-tuning approaches

scope.detail: Analysis becomes significantly more complex with multi-token responses

evaluation.detail: Only tested on Llama-2 and Llama-3.1
evaluation.impact: Generalization to other model families unclear

evaluation.detail: Theory depends on specific preference structure
evaluation.impact: May not hold for diverse preference domains

papers.relevance_to_sft: Shows theoretical gap in understanding selective preference optimization, demonstrates finite-step training considerations important for SFT, highlights complexity of preference-based selective learning

papers.title: DEPT: Decoupled Embeddings for Pre-Training Language Models

heterogeneous_data.detail: Diverse sources compete for model capacity
heterogeneous_data.impact: Cannot uniformly fine-tune on mixed domains

heterogeneous_data.detail: Adding languages yields diminishing returns for low-resource languages

vocabulary.impact: Poor fine-tuning performance on low-resource domains

inference.detail: SPEC models limited to broadest or closest embedding matrix
inference.impact: Reduced generalization to unseen data mixtures

inference.detail: Requires final global embedding despite decoupling

scalability.detail: Providing tokens for all languages results in impractically large models
scalability.impact: Limits scalability of selective vocabulary approaches

papers.relevance_to_sft: Shows heterogeneous fine-tuning requires careful vocabulary/embedding handling, demonstrates negative interference in multi-domain settings, illustrates importance of selective parameter updates for efficiency, highlights critical challenges of combining domains

generalization_vs_specialization.description: Tension between maintaining pre-training knowledge and adapting to target domain
generalization_vs_specialization.sft_relevance: Selective fine-tuning must balance these through careful parameter selection

data_heterogeneity.description: Inconsistent labeling, competing capacity, different semantic structures across domains
data_heterogeneity.sft_relevance: Cannot use uniform fine-tuning strategy; selective methods must handle domain-specific inconsistencies

computational_efficiency_vs_capability.description: Trade-offs between gradient computation, memory, speed, and parameter efficiency
computational_efficiency_vs_capability.sft_relevance: Selective methods must justify parameter selection through capability analysis, not just efficiency

limited_theoretical_understanding.description: Immature theory for preference learning, knowledge structures, and generalization mechanisms
limited_theoretical_understanding.sft_relevance: Need rigorous framework for understanding which parameters affect which capabilities

evaluation_scope_limitations.description: Limited benchmark coverage, narrow task domains, simulation-only evaluation
evaluation_scope_limitations.sft_relevance: SFT evaluation should cover broader capability spectrum, not just narrow benchmarks

low_resource_challenges.description: Limited target data, underrepresentation, overfitting risks in low-resource settings
low_resource_challenges.sft_relevance: Selective methods essential for low-resource scenarios but need special handling

anticipated_reviewer_criticisms.criticism: Limited theoretical justification for parameter selection
Evaluation on too narrow benchmark set
Computational savings not clearly demonstrated vs. alternatives
